company.shortDescription: Quanta provides software companies with real-time financial clarity and empowerment.
company.description: Quanta provides software companies with real-time financial clarity and empowerment. Quanta envision a world in which all business accounting tasks that are not creative in nature are automated, leaving finance teams and business owners to focus solely on strategic and creative work.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based accounting platform and general ledger that synchronizes transactions, reconciles books, automates accounting workflows, and provides current financial reporting for software companies.
productsAndServices.name: Quanta Platform

productsAndServices.description: Managed bookkeeping delivered through Quanta’s accounting platform, including transaction processing, account reconciliation, financial categorization, and ongoing maintenance of the general ledger.
productsAndServices.name: Bookkeeping Services

productsAndServices.description: Accounting oversight and operational support that applies review, accounting judgment, exception resolution, and additional structure to a company’s financial records and reporting.
productsAndServices.name: Controller Services

productsAndServices.description: Back-office financial support for founders, finance leaders, and fractional CFOs, including current financial reporting, SaaS metrics, and explanations of business performance.
productsAndServices.name: CFO Support

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $12,717,805 to $90,226,360, a 7.09x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
